edition.witness_note: Lake 1912 Loeb copy-text; Lightfoot/Funk middle recension not yet locked as second witness

source_text: [1] Ἐπεὶ οὖν ἐν τοῖς προγεγραμμένοις προσώποις τὸ πᾶν πλῆθος ἐθεώρησα ἐν πίστει καὶ ἠγάπησα, παραινῶ, ἐν ὁμονοίᾳ θεοῦ σπουδάζετε πάντα πράσσειν, προκαθημένου τοῦ ἐπισκόπου εἰς τόπον θεοῦ καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων εἰς τόπον συνεδρίου τῶν ἀποστόλων, καὶ τῶν διακόνων τῶν ἐμοὶ γλυκυτάτων πεπιστευμένων διακονίαν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, δς πρὸ αἰώνων παρὰ πατρὶ ἦν καὶ ἐν τέλει ἐφάνη. [2] πάντες οὖν ὁμοήθειαν θεοῦ λαβόντες ἐντρέπεσθε ἀλλήλους καὶ μηδεὶς κατὰ σάρκα βλεπέτω τὸν πλησίον, ἀλλ’ ἐν Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ ἀλλήλους διὰ παντὸς ἀγαπᾶτε. μηδὲν ἔστω ἐν ὑμῖν, ὃ δυνήσεται ὑμᾶς μερίσαι ἀλλ’ ἑνώθητε τῷ ἐπισκόπῳ καὶ τοῖς προκαθημένοις εἰς τύπον καὶ διδαχὴν ἀφθαρσίας.
pass_a_gloss: Because I observed the entire multitude, in faith, in the persons described above, and loved it, I exhort you: strive to act in all things in the concord of God, the bishop presiding in God's place and the presbyters in place of the apostles' council, and the deacons, sweetest to me, having been entrusted with Jesus Christ's service; he before the ages was beside the Father and was manifested at the end. Therefore all, having taken up God's sameness of character, show respect to each other, and let nobody view the neighbor in a fleshly way, but in Jesus Christ continually love each other. Let nothing exist among you which will be able to divide you; rather, be made one with the bishop and with the presiding ones, for a pattern and teaching of incorruptibility.
pass_b_english: In the persons I have named I have looked on your whole congregation in faith, and I have loved it. So I urge you: be eager to do everything in God's own harmony, with the bishop presiding in the place of God, the presbyters in the place of the council of the apostles, and the deacons, so very dear to me, entrusted with the ministry of Jesus Christ, who was with the Father before the ages and at the end was revealed.

All of you, then, having received God's own character, respect one another. Let no one regard his neighbor according to the flesh; love one another in Jesus Christ, always. Let nothing be among you that could divide you. Be one with the bishop and with those who preside, as a pattern and a lesson of incorruption.

choices.why: Literal; the bishop's seat images God's, the presbyters' the apostles' council.
ὁμοήθεια is likeness of habit or character; the aorist participle λαβόντες is kept as something already received, not turned into a command.

choices.english: a pattern and a lesson of incorruption
choices.why: ἀφθαρσία is incorruption; the united church both shows and teaches it.
rejected: type and evidence of your immortality

choices.english: looked on your whole congregation in faith, and I have loved it
choices.why: ἠγάπησα is a finite verb, not a noun 'love'.

anf_compare.notes: Minor. ANF reads 'in faith and love' where the Greek has 'beheld in faith and loved'; ANF 'type and evidence of your immortality' paraphrases τύπον καὶ διδαχὴν ἀφθαρσίας (pattern and teaching of incorruption). Church order sense is the same.

notes: 'With the Father before the ages' may echo John 1:1-2 or John 17:5; 'at the end was revealed' may echo Hebrews 9:26 or 1 Peter 1:20. Wording not close enough to cite inline.
Source shows 'δς' for ὃς; reproduced as supplied.

review.notes: Paragraph [1] is Magnesians 6, from Ἐπεὶ οὖν ἐν τοῖς προγεγραμμένοις προσώποις τὸ πᾶν πλῆθος ἐθεώρησα ἐν πίστει καὶ ἠγάπησα through εἰς τύπον καὶ διδαχὴν ἀφθαρσίας. Pass A keeps the causal exhortation, bishop εἰς τόπον θεοῦ, presbyters εἰς τόπον συνεδρίου τῶν ἀποστόλων, deacons πεπιστευμένων διακονίαν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, and Christ πρὸ αἰώνων παρὰ πατρὶ ἦν καὶ ἐν τέλει ἐφάνη; μηδεὶς κατὰ σάρκα and ὃ δυνήσεται ὑμᾶς μερίσαι stay prohibitions of division, and ἑνώθητε remains the hearers' union with the bishop and τοῖς προκαθημένοις. Pass B does not reverse those clauses. No inline citation is present to mismatch. Title names the bishop's place, not only the locus. OCR δς is disclosed.

Paragraph 1: Greek matches Ignatius Magnesians 6. Pass A renders Ἐπεὶ οὖν ἐν τοῖς προγεγραμμένοις προσώποις τὸ πᾶν πλῆθος ἐθεώρησα ἐν πίστει καὶ ἠγάπησα as 'Because I observed the entire multitude, in faith, in the persons described above, and loved it' preserving clause sense; Pass B matches closely in both sentences, adding no contradiction. Completeness: all Greek clauses rendered (exhortation, bishop/presbyters/deacons roles, Christ's pre-existence and manifestation, exhortation to unity, rejection of fleshly viewing, love in Christ, avoidance of division, unity with leaders as pattern/teaching of incorruptibility). Negation: 'μηδὲν ἔστω ... ὃ δυνήσεται ὑμᾶς μερίσαι' rendered 'Let nothing exist among you which will be able to divide you' preserving negation and agency. Agency: clear who acts (Ignatius exhorts, bishop presides, deacons entrusted, Christ was with Father). Modality: παραινῶ (I exhort), σπουδάζετε (strive), ἔστω (let be), ἑνώθητε (be made one) preserved. Doctrine: Christ's pre-existence (πρὸ αἰώνων παρὰ πατρὶ ἦν) and manifestation (ἐν τέλει ἐφάνη) retained. Scripture: no inline citations in Greek; notes correctly state no close enough wording to cite, no false citation added. Title 'The Bishop in God's Place' names the thought (bishop's divine role), not just locus. No uncertainties; all checks passed.
